producer_report.summary: Added an automation register module in athena-core. Each entry has a name, owner, cost, measured savings and its source toil or repeat cause. `register` refuses an entry with no savings, owner, name or source. `review` lists entries costing more than they save for retirement, and lists entries with no savings separately. OLY-B-A9-01 in docs/spec.toml now names the module and the test file, and its measure ends `status: not shown`. A new test file covers the retire, keep and refuse outcomes and checks the real spec entry. CHANGELOG.md and xtask/shard-timings.txt are updated. The rule is not wired into the drain or any gate.

criteria_check.criterion: In docs/spec.toml, OLY-B-A9-01 has mechanism no longer "none", naming crates/athena-core/src/automation.rs and the test file crates/athena-core/tests/automation_register.rs; owner stays Athena.
criteria_check.evidence: Edited docs/spec.toml; test spec_entry_has_a_real_mechanism asserts mechanism, both paths and owner Athena; passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The OLY-B-A9-01 measure in docs/spec.toml says how the requirement is shown, names `cargo test -p athena-core --test automation_register`, and ends with `status: not shown` (no label from STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs is claimed that athena status does not print).
criteria_check.evidence: Measure text ends 'status: not shown' and names the command; the spec test checks both plus measure_problem == None; passes.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/automation.rs defines an automation register entry (name, owner, build/run cost, measured savings, source toil or repeat cause) and a pure function returning the entries whose cost exceeds their savings, plus entries lacking savings registration; it is exported from crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs.
criteria_check.evidence: automation.rs defines Automation, register, registration_problem and review (returns retire and unregistered lists); `pub mod automation;` added to lib.rs.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core --test automation_register`: tests show an automation costing more than it saves is listed for retirement, one saving more is kept, an entry with no savings is refused, and the real docs/spec.toml entry for OLY-B-A9-01 has a non-none mechanism, owner Athena, a passing measure_problem, and is absent from spec_gaps. The spec test fails if the mechanism reverts to "none".
criteria_check.evidence: Ran the command: 6 tests pass, covering retire, keep, refuse, and the real spec entry. spec_gaps absence assertion would fail with mechanism none (spec_check_refuses_a_none_mechanism shows none yields a gap).

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy`, and `cargo test` (or the Athena-recorded passing checks on the same tree): all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran cargo fmt --all and clippy -p athena-core with -D warnings (clean), plus the policy and mirrors tests.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md records the change; no existing entry of docs/decisions.md or records/ is edited.
criteria_check.evidence: Added an entry under Unreleased/Added in CHANGELOG.md; docs/decisions.md and records/ untouched.

mistakes: The first test draft borrowed a temporary in review(&[entry(..)]) and failed to compile; fixed with a let binding.
learnings: The producer Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm; no cd, grep, head or tail, and no pipes into them.
New test files need a line in xtask/shard-timings.txt.
